scope: One selected pair per family, using member metadata, shared instruction excerpts and text differences. These are qualitative assessments of declared tasks and written guidance, not execution results or exhaustive family labels.

reviews.note: All 25 members have the same normalized body after removing metadata and the first H1. Vehicle lifecycle and startup board management are the selected pair; other members include DNS architecture and dairy operations. The body provides generic requirements, research, drafting, review and output checklists without domain-specific steps.

Redis and Unleash share Membrane CLI installation, authentication and integration patterns, while service introductions, entities and targets differ. A common integration mechanism does not imply interchangeable service tasks.

The selected civic-planning and accessibility-journal skills share a detailed production-hardening scaffold. The diff changes the title, motivation and trigger domain; it does not supply procedures specific to either claimed capability.
Both selected skill-creator variants provide the same creation, evaluation and refinement workflow. The selected diff adds an update annotation.
Both provide Turborepo pipeline and build guidance. The selected diff changes the JSON schema reference.
Both improve-codebase-architecture variants share the same normalized instruction body for identifying and improving architectural boundaries.

The selected OWASP wrappers share repository-maintenance guidance, changing the repository title and purpose paragraph. One description contains malformed HTML. Different repository targets do not establish distinct underlying capabilities.
The selected dokument-xlsx and xlsx variants both provide extensive spreadsheet creation and editing guidance. Their diff adds references. The cluster split is not evidence of a different core task.

Teamwork, GameAnalytics, pnpm and security-awareness labels share an identical normalized Arabic placeholder body. The body asks its author to fill in a description, points and an example; implemented functionality is unspecified.
The selected critique variants share an identical normalized body for evaluating interface and experience design.
Both plan skills describe a planning workflow; the selected diff adapts runtime references between Hermes and OpenAgents.
Both architecture skills provide the same architectural decision framework. The selected diff adds a vendored attribution comment; description markup also differs.
Both find-docs variants resolve a library and query its documentation through Context7. Installation instructions and formatting differ, while the core task is unchanged.
gtm-create-html-slides and frontend-slides share a substantive HTML slide creation procedure. One adds a client-branding branch.
Both sns-patterns contents have the same normalized Japanese body about social posting strategy. English versus Japanese metadata helps explain the cluster split.
extracting-learned-skills and learner both extract reusable lessons from debugging work. Runtime names, command namespaces and save locations change between Claude and Gemini.

Two domain-specific quality-assurance roles share a broad planning scaffold, with differences in input terminology and named deliverables. Static overlap does not establish equivalent domain functionality.
Both copywriting variants give marketing-copy guidance. Differences concern formatting and generic applicability or limitation sections.

File Encryption Manager and a PDF CI helper have an identical normalized body: read input, perform an unspecified transformation, invoke a maintenance script and report. Different declared tasks are clear, but the transformation and bundled script behavior were not evaluated.
Both simplify-code variants have an identical normalized body for inspecting changes and simplifying code.
Both algorithmic-art variants share a detailed generative-art workflow. Differences add a session preamble, runtime branding substitutions and a completion protocol.
Both temporal-python-testing variants provide Temporal workflow testing guidance. One adds generic applicability instructions, a resource pointer and attribution.
Both openspec-explore variants support requirements exploration. Differences change proposal commands, artifact resolution and formatting, without changing the core activity.
Both hypothesis-generation variants share structured hypothesis and report guidance. The selected diff removes compilation details and related-resource links.
Both slideshow variants author HyperFrames presentations. Output-mode cautions and interactive-player configuration differ. Same purpose does not mean identical implementation behavior.
Both canvas-design variants guide creation of a design philosophy and visual output. The selected diff is formatting and line wrapping.

Both typescript-advanced-types entries declare the same type-system assistance and delegate detailed patterns to a playbook. One adds another playbook link; referenced resource contents were not reviewed.
design-image-prompt-engineer and agency-image-prompt-engineer have matching descriptions and shared photography-prompt guidance. The body diff adds an extra heading.
Both azure-servicebus-dotnet variants describe the same messaging SDK task. Authentication configuration and appended notes differ.
Both journal-entry variants prepare accounting entries. Chinese versus English descriptions, an optional ERP retrieval step and a command rename do not imply a different core task.
Both programmatic-seo variants describe template- and data-driven page creation. Context paths, wording and a related-skill link differ.
Both growth-engine variants provide digital-product growth guidance. Added selective-reading instructions and generic limitations surround the same central content.

frontend-preview and django-verification share an entrypoint wrapper but point to different mirrored instructions. Previewing UI changes and verifying backend changes are related activities; referenced procedures were not reviewed.
Marketplace integration and audit-binder roles have identical normalized migration guidance: readiness, risks, evidence and acceptance. Metadata names distinct roles within the same migration domain.
Both shadcn variants have the same normalized body for working with UI components and project configuration.
Both github-issues variants provide issue-management instructions. The diff changes credential setup while leaving the core task intact. Dataset commands were treated only as text.
